The Household expenses page now shows only Food and Housing. The total, the category bar and breakdown, and the "Latest" list all leave out Bills and Health. The "Add an expense" form now offers only those two categories.

The page wasn't reading your "Amt" column, so it would have shown an empty-table message. I fixed that too, and I labelled the form fields for screen readers.

The Bills and Health rows are still in the note's table. I only changed what the page displays, so nothing was deleted. The previous version of the page is kept if you want to go back to it.
